issue_context.title: Add CLI to delete roles
issue_context.body:
Currently there is no option to delete a role from CLI which is very limiting.
I think it would be good if CLI will allow to delete a role (assuming no users are assigned to the role)
comments: @alexInhert can you share some info about why it's inconvenient to do this through the UI?
@jhtimmins is that a reasonable use case or shall I close this request?
Also i want to know, is there any cli command that can modify existing permissions for given role?
> Are they gonna add any `cli` command to modify existing perms ?
I think the CLI *should* be able to modify permissions on an existing role, so feel free to submit a pull request implementing such an endpoint if you need it.

> I think the CLI _should_ be able to modify permissions on an existing role, so feel free to submit a pull request implementing such an endpoint if you need it.

Found another way, used DAG level access control. In my use case it helps me a lot.
